settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDescription: Choose the visual theme for menus and other UI panels.
settings.shortcutsDescription: Customize keyboard shortcuts for common actions.
settings.audioDescription: Choose what plays and how loud it is. Nothing plays until you interact with the page, and every choice here is remembered on this device.
settings.audioMuteHelp: Silences music and sound effects right now, including anything already playing. Your two volume settings and your two on/off choices are remembered, so turning Mute off again brings back exactly what you had. Turning a bus off below is a different choice, and is remembered on its own.
settings.audioMusicHelp: Turns background music on or off. This choice is remembered separately from Mute, and the volume below is kept whether music is on or off.
settings.audioMusicVolumeHelp: How loud music plays. Move it with the left and right arrow keys, or with Home and End for silent and full.
settings.audioSfxHelp: Turns the short sounds - steps, pickups, and feedback - on or off. This choice is remembered separately from Mute, and the volume below is kept whether effects are on or off.
settings.audioSfxVolumeHelp: How loud the short sounds play. Move it with the left and right arrow keys, or with Home and End for silent and full.
settings.audioSummaryMuted: Muted now. Nothing plays, and your volumes and on/off choices are kept for when you unmute.
settings.audioSummaryOn: Sound is on. Music and sound effects use the levels you set here.

errors.recoveryNote: Some data may have been recovered from a backup.
